provenance.inputs: Original text descriptions; packing edit references only the first self-generated sheets. No third-party images or Character Lab art.
provenance.edits: Reduced poses within the uniform cells to provide transparent margins.
provenance.limitations: Eight generated held poses; per-pose manual support/contact/hand calibration is in pilotGeometry.ts. Grim dodge and KO have source-edge clipping and need later art cleanup; metadata cannot restore missing pixels.

poseAnchors.coordinates: Cell-local pixels in the 384x512 sprite sheet
poseAnchors.scalePolicy: one uniform scale per actor and framing; no pose bounding-box normalization
